units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 3:4:5">Y. Shebi. III, end, 34ᵈ</cite> <he>צא חצי טפח לס׳ וכ׳</he> deduct half a handbreadth for chiselling on one side &c.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 9:1:4">Y. Sabb. IX, 11ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>סִיתּוּתָן של אבנים וכ׳</he> the chiselling (smoothing) of stones is the finishing touch on them; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 3:6:4">Y. Ab. Zar. III, 43ᵇ</cite> top <he>סתיתן</he> (read <he>סתו׳</he>). Ib. IV, 43ᵈ bot. <he>על כל ס׳ וס׳</he> at every stroke by which he breaks the stone loose in the quarry; a. e.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Metzia 10:5:2">Y. B. Mets. X, end, 12ᶜ</cite> <he>והוזק בין בס׳ וכ׳</he> and a person was hurt either by a chip or by the stone itself.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Metzia 10:5:2">Ib.</cite> [read:] <he>אחר שמסרה הסתת לסבל והוזק בס׳ וכ׳</he> if a person was hurt after the stone-cutter had delivered it to the carrier, if by a chip, the cutter is responsible &c.
